fits.label: Fits
fits.help: The fits a product can have (regular, slim …). Each size chart is for one garment type and one fit.

fallbackFit.label: Fit used when a product has none
fallbackFit.help: A product without a fit, or with a fit that has no chart in its category, gets the chart of this fit.

diagrams.label: How-to-measure drawings
diagrams.help: The drawings a size chart can show under it (tops, bottoms …).

diagramFor.label: Drawing per garment type
diagramFor.help: Which drawing a new chart of a garment type starts with. A type not listed starts with the first drawing.

howToMeasure.label: How to measure
howToMeasure.help: One line per measurement. Customers only see the lines of the measurements their product's chart has.

defaultEaseInch.label: Starting room for Find my size (inches)
defaultEaseInch.help: How much room a new chart's garment has over the body. Each chart can change it.

valueStepInch.label: Measurement step (inches)
valueStepInch.help: The step of the measurement boxes, and the rounding of a suggested new row.

maxValueInch.label: Largest measurement (inches)
maxValueInch.help: A box above this is a typing mistake and is refused.

maxRows.label: Most sizes in one chart
maxRows.help: How many size rows one chart may have.

cmDecimals.label: Decimals in cm
cmDecimals.help: How cm is rounded when it is worked out from inches (0 = whole cm).

seasons.label: Seasons
seasons.help: The seasons a seasonal collection can belong to (Eid, winter …). A seasonal page is permanent and comes back every year.

pathPrefix.label: Collection page address
pathPrefix.help: Collection pages live under this part of the address, e.g. /collections/winter.

maxProducts.label: Most products in one collection
maxProducts.help: How many products one collection may hold.

maxPerProduct.label: Most tags on one product
maxPerProduct.help: How many tags one product may carry.

columns.label: CSV columns
columns.help: The columns an export writes, in this order. Product and SKU always stay. Cost prices are never exported.

maxRows.label: Most rows in one import
maxRows.help: A file with more rows is refused; split it into parts.

delimiter.label: Column separator
delimiter.help: What separates the columns: a comma, a semicolon or a tab.

listSeparator.label: Separator inside a cell
listSeparator.help: What separates several tags or collections in one cell.

maxRowReports.label: Rows reported in a preview
maxRowReports.help: How many row results a preview lists; the totals always count every row.

defaultSource.label: Where a struck-through price comes from
defaultSource.help: Empty or None = no struck-through price anywhere. Brand MRP, the real price history or the combo sum. Each category and product can choose its own. This is the owner's decision.

historyDays.label: Price history days
historyDays.help: With price history, the struck-through price is the lowest real price of this many days before the current one.

mrpOwnLabel.label: Allow MRP on own-label products
mrpOwnLabel.help: Off: an MRP is only shown for genuine branded goods, never for the shop's own label.

howToMeasure.chest: Chest — across under the arms, then double it
howToMeasure.length: Length — from the top of the shoulder to the hem
howToMeasure.shoulder: Shoulder — seam to seam across the back
howToMeasure.sleeve: Sleeve — shoulder seam to the cuff
howToMeasure.waist: Waist — across the waistband, then double it
howToMeasure.hip: Hip — widest part, then double it
howToMeasure.thigh: Thigh — across the leg just under the crotch
